mapper.select: SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, pl.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON pl.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON pl.auditor_user = au.id WHERE pl.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, pl.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON pl.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON pl.auditor_user = au.id ORDER BY pl.entry_date DESC, pl.update_time DESC, pl.create_time DESC

SELECT pl.id, pl.uuid, pl.project_id AS projectId, pl.list_name AS listName, pl.list_type AS listType, c.customer_name AS customerName, pl.entry_date AS entryDate, pl.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, pl.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, pl.pdf_attachment_id AS pdfAttachmentId, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.create_user AS createUser, pl.update_time AS updateTime, pl.update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list pl LEFT JOIN project_basic_info p ON pl.project_id = p.uuid LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON p.customer_id = c.uuid LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON pl.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON pl.auditor_user = au.id WHERE pl.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pl.entry_date DESC, pl.update_time DESC, pl.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_list ( uuid, project_id, list_name, list_type, entry_date, entry_user, auditor_user, pdf_attachment_id, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{projectId}, #{listName}, #{listType}, #{entryDate}, #{entryUser}, #{auditorUser}, #{pdfAttachmentId}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
